summary: Built CycloneDX and SPDX SBOMs of sbom-demo with syft 1.57.2 (5 components from package-lock.json), generated a throwaway cosign key pair in /tmp, signed sbom.cdx.json offline with cosign 3.1.4 (empty signing config: no Rekor/Fulcio/OIDC/TSA), and verified the bundle: Verified OK. The signature attests this run only; it is not tied to a real identity.

hypotheses.title: Signature bundle carries no transparency-log proof
hypotheses.rationale: By design: the run signs offline with a throwaway key (the signing config lists no Rekor, Fulcio, OIDC or TSA service). The bundle proves the SBOM was not modified after signing inside this sandbox; it does not prove who signed it or when.
hypotheses.next_step: For provenance a third party can check, sign in CI with cosign keyless (Fulcio certificate + Rekor inclusion proof) and drop --insecure-ignore-tlog from verification.
